dag_infos.description: Taipei sports venue booking system venue list and locations.

data_infos.source_type: Taipei sports venue booking API and HTML detail pages
data_infos.dataset_description: 臺北市政府體育局場地租借系統運動場館資料，包含場館名稱、主場館、行政區、開放狀態、容納人數、面積、租借狀態、照片與座標。
data_infos.etl_description: POST venue list API, fetch each venue detail page, parse VLatLon/static map coordinates, normalize image URL, classify venue category from name with TWCC AI, generate WGS84 points, then write PostgreSQL.
